name: Amazon Fire 7 (9th Gen, 2019) Fire OS 7.3.3.1 (mustang)

packages.title: Lockscreen Ads / Special Offers
packages.reason: Consistently pulls lockscreen advertisements and wakes CPU, taking 90MB+ RAM. (Protected by Fire OS 7.3.3.1 PackageManagerService; restricted via appops instead).

packages.title: Alexa Multimodal Service
packages.reason: Background voice assistant daemons consuming ~80MB RAM on idle.
packages.effects: Disables Alexa background listening and smart screen visual modes.
